scope: 1937 Marco Polo Bridge through end-1938 major China campaigns; vehicle-layer incremental effect only

historical_anchors.Shanghai_5th_Tank_Battalion: 32 Type89 + 15 Type94 tankettes = 47 AFVs in one documented Shanghai tank battalion.
historical_anchors.early_China_armored_scale: A commonly cited deployment anchor gives 78 Type89 + 41 Type94 tankettes in the initial China advance; other battalions/light-armor companies were also used at different dates.
historical_anchors.campaign_character: Japanese armor was principally infantry-support/exploitation armor; Chinese armored opposition was sparse, while urban fighting, AT guns, roads, bridges and maintenance were important.
historical_anchors.guard: Do not sum all dated OOB snapshots as unique national vehicles; units and hulls can overlap between operations.

branch_effect.main_source: lower mechanical dropout + better parts/recovery; gun/armor unchanged
branch_effect.contact_effect: slightly more assault/exploitation cycles; also slightly more exposure

first_pass_cumulative_delta_1937_38.Japanese_AFV_irrecoverable_loss_delta: -7 to -15 hulls versus historical-equivalent vehicle quality
first_pass_cumulative_delta_1937_38.Japanese_AFV_damaged_contacts: roughly unchanged to +5% because additional sorties offset reliability improvement
first_pass_cumulative_delta_1937_38.Japanese_other_equipment_saved: 2-5 guns and 15-35 trucks/tractors/equivalent from fewer local collapses/abandonments

operational_effect.local: Some strongpoints/road axes fail hours earlier; Japanese local exploitation reaches the next line more consistently.
operational_effect.strategic: No new major city/campaign outcome is created solely by vehicles. Existing Branch assumption that 1937-38 China is somewhat weaker can retain this as one incremental contributor, not a second full multiplier.
operational_effect.long_term: A few more rebuildable hulls and trained crews survive into 1939-41; institutional confidence in reliable armor is modestly stronger.

next: Use regiment/battalion archival loss returns if found; otherwise keep this as a cumulative band rather than fake campaign-by-campaign precision.
